A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''officer''' operated for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a [[Non-commissioned officer/Legends|non-commissioned officer]] after he graduated from the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Military Academy]] as an honors candidate. During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] was under the employ of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] and Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]], and was stationed on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]], in Jerec's [[Government House (Sulon)|Government House]]. After the fledgling [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyle Katarn]] [[Mission to Sulon|dueled]] the Dark Jedi [[Yun]] and won, the officer and several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] arrived on the scene. However, upon realizing that Katarn was a Jedi, the troopers attempted to escape. The officer was forced to shoot one trooper in the knee in order to get them to fight Katarn. However, they were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] by Katarn.
